title_i18n.zh: OpenAI 详解 GPT-Live 架构如何实现了连续的有状态语音交互
title_i18n.en: OpenAI details how the GPT-Live architecture enables continuous, stateful voice interaction.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 最近，OpenAI 发布了一篇关于 GPT-Live 的工程报告。该报告详细描述了他们如何设计这个系统，将对延迟敏感的媒体处理与更广泛的应用工作分离，同时保持语音交互的连续性。
excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, OpenAI released an engineering report on GPT-Live. The report details how they designed the system to separate latency-sensitive media processing from broader application work while maintaining continuity in voice interaction.

items.title: AI Coding 在大型客户端工程中的落地实践——从通才模型到专才 Agent｜QCon上海
items.raw_excerpt: 推理模型持续突破能力边界，Coding Agent 深度参与研发流程，Agent Runtime、Agent Framework 快速演进……AI 正在从回答问题的模型，演变为能够自主规划、调用工具、执行任务的软件系统。AI 不再只是软件中的一个能力，而开始成为软件系统的一部分。这意味着软件工程面对的挑战也发生了变化：团队需要思考的不再只是如何训练模型、模型、部署模型 或优化 Prompt，而不是如何让具备自主能力的 AI 稳定、可信、可控地运行。 模型决定 AI 能做什么，系统决定 AI 能否真正创造价值。

title_i18n.zh: AI Coding 在大型客户端工程中的落地实践——从通才模型到专才 Agent｜QCon上海
title_i18n.en: AI Coding Implementation Practices in Large-Scale Client Engineering — From Generalist Models to Specialist Agents | QCon Shanghai
title_i18n.es: Prácticas de implementación de AI Coding en la ingeniería de clientes a gran escala: del modelo generalista al agente especializado | QCon Shanghai

excerpt_i18n.zh: 推理模型持续突破能力边界，Coding Agent 深度参与研发流程，Agent Runtime、Agent Framework 快速演进……AI 正在从回答问题的模型，演变为能够自主规划、调用工具、执行任务的软件系统。AI 不再只是软件中的一个能力，而开始成为软件系统的一部分。这意味着软件工程面对的挑战也发生了变化：团队需要思考的不再只是如何训练模型、模型、部署模型 或优化 Prompt，而不是如何让具备自主能力的 AI 稳定、可信、可控地运行。 模型决定 AI 能做什么，系统决定 AI 能否真正创造价值。
excerpt_i18n.en: Reasoning models continue to break through capability boundaries, Coding Agents are deeply involved in the R&D process, and Agent Runtime and Agent Framework are evolving rapidly... AI is transforming from a model that answers questions into a software system that can autonomously plan, call tools, and execute tasks. AI is no longer just a capability within software—it is becoming part of the software system itself. This means the challenges faced by software engineering have also shifted: teams no longer need to think only about how to train models, deploy models, or optimize prompts, but rather how to make autonomous AI run stably, reliably, and controllably. Models determine what AI can do; systems determine whether AI can truly create value.
excerpt_i18n.es: Los modelos de razonamiento continúan superando los límites de sus capacidades, los Coding Agents participan profundamente en los procesos de desarrollo, Agent Runtime y Agent Framework evolucionan rápidamente… La IA está pasando de ser un modelo que responde preguntas a convertirse en un sistema de software capaz de planificar de forma autónoma, invocar herramientas y ejecutar tareas. La IA ya no es solo una capacidad dentro del software, sino que comienza a formar parte de los sistemas de software. Esto significa que los desafíos a los que se enfrenta la ingeniería de software también han cambiado: los equipos ya no necesitan pensar únicamente en cómo entrenar modelos, implementar modelos u optimizar prompts, sino en cómo lograr que la IA con capacidades autónomas sea estable y fiable.

items.title: Stable Singularity of the Euler Equations on R^3 without forcing – Anima on AI
items.raw_excerpt: In the theory of partial differential equations (PDEs), an important problem is analyzing whether there is loss of regularity in finite time, even when there is smooth initial data. This is known as singularity formation, or blowups. A famous one is whether fluid dynamics represented by Navier-Stokes equations experiences such blowups, and is one of the unsolved Millennium prize problems.

title_i18n.en: Stable Singularity of the Euler Equations on R^3 without forcing – Anima on AI
title_i18n.zh: 欧拉方程在R^3上无强迫的稳定奇点——Anima on AI
title_i18n.es: Singularidad estable de las ecuaciones de Euler en R^3 sin forzamiento – Anima sobre IA

excerpt_i18n.en: In the theory of partial differential equations (PDEs), an important problem is analyzing whether there is loss of regularity in finite time, even when there is smooth initial data. This is known as singularity formation, or blowups. A famous one is whether fluid dynamics represented by Navier-Stokes equations experiences such blowups, and is one of the unsolved Millennium prize problems.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 在偏微分方程（PDE）理论中，一个重要问题是分析即使在初始数据光滑的情况下，是否会在有限时间内失去正则性。这被称为奇点形成。
excerpt_i18n.es: En la teoría de las ecuaciones en derivadas parciales (EDP), un problema importante es analizar si hay pérdida de regularidad en tiempo finito, incluso cuando los datos iniciales son suaves. Esto se conoce como formación de singularidades.

items.title: AI crawler user-agents are being spoofed to reach cloud metadata endpoints
items.raw_excerpt: The scanners spoofing AI crawler user-agents to hunt credentials turned out to be one HTTP client running on 26 addresses. On 25 August it switched from nine fixed strings to a generator that has produced 6,648 different spellings of Claude-User alone, which breaks every allow-list that matches on the name.

title_i18n.en: AI crawler user-agents are being spoofed to reach cloud metadata endpoints
title_i18n.zh: AI爬虫的User-Agent正被伪造，以访问云元数据端点。

excerpt_i18n.en: The scanners spoofing AI crawler user-agents to hunt credentials turned out to be one HTTP client running on 26 addresses. On 25 August it switched from nine fixed strings to a generator that has produced 6,648 different spellings of Claude-User alone, which breaks every allow-list that matches on the name.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 这些伪装成AI爬虫用户代理以窃取凭证的扫描器，实际上是运行在26个地址上的同一个HTTP客户端。8月25日，它从使用九个固定字符串切换为使用一个生成器，该生成器已产生6,648种不同字符串。

items.raw_excerpt: 雷峰网独家获悉，今天早上，微软通过内部邮件宣布了一项组织调整：微软亚太区业务（主要是云业务）“一分为二”，日本、韩国、澳大利亚与新西兰市场由微软日本负责人津坂美树负责，大中华区、东盟与印度市场由微软大中华区原一把手侯阳负责。 这次变动，是此前微软亚太区总裁 Rodrigo Kede Lima 调任后引发的连锁调整。 今年 7 月初，微软成立了新的内部事业部 Microsoft Frontier Company，专注把“前线部署工程师”（FDE）这套模式推向市场，将 AI 嵌进客户的核心业务流中。Rodrigo Kede Lima 随即调任该部门，其原职位出现空缺，进而促成了此次“一拆二”的重组。 雷峰网雷峰网 关于此次人事调整背后的博弈故事，可添加作者微信  xf123a  交流。 ▼ 推荐阅读 ▼ AI人才3次大迁徙：百度先行、六小虎分化、腾讯「腾笼换鸟」 2026-08-25 独家丨从飞书火山整合，看阿里「云钉一体」踩过的坑 2026-08-05

The Japan, South Korea, Australia, and New Zealand markets will be led by Miki Tsusaka, head of Microsoft Japan, while the Greater China, ASEAN, and India markets will be led by Hou Yang, former head of Microsoft Greater China. excerpt_i18n.zh: 《西雅图时报》和《新闻日报》是最新起诉OpenAI的原告，指控其侵犯版权。两家媒体表示，该公司未经许可将其新闻报道用作AI模型的训练数据。
excerpt_i18n.es: The Seattle Times y Newsday no son más que los últimos demandantes en llevar a OpenAI a los tribunales, alegando infracción de los derechos de autor. Los dos medios afirman que la empresa utilizó su periodismo como datos de entrenamiento para sus modelos de IA sin permiso.
